seo.title: Lighthouse Resort & Marina | Cabins & Boat Rentals
seo.description: Lake Texoma cabins, waterfront RV sites, covered slips, a year-round fuel dock, and tritoon and kayak rentals at Lighthouse Resort in Pottsboro, Texas.

heroImage.alt: Lighthouse marina, wooded shoreline, and Lake Texoma

home.heroKicker: The Most Exciting place on Lake Texoma
home.heroSubtitle: Cabins, waterfront RV sites, and boats ready for your crew. A whole Lake Texoma weekend, together in one place.

intro.title: Lake Texoma’s family fun spot. With everything close at hand.
body: Settle into a cabin or pull up in your RV. Walk down to the marina. Rent a boat, cast from the pier, or simply spend a little more time together. It all comes together on one point in Little Mineral, near Denison Dam.
Lighthouse began as Preston Fishing Camp after the lake filled in 1944. Today, that same love of the lake runs through every cabin, dock, and family weekend.

features.title: Cabins for every size of crew
features.body: One-room waterfront cabins for a fishing trip, two- and three-bedroom family cabins, and six-bedroom houses for the whole reunion. All climate-controlled with cable, linens, dishes, a grill and a coffee pot; several are pet friendly.

features.title: Waterfront RV sites
features.body: Graveled sites steps from the shoreline and the marina with 30/50-amp power, water, a picnic table and fire ring, and a dump station on property. Pull in, plug in, and walk to the fuel dock for ice.

features.title: The newest rental fleet on the lake
features.body: Berkshire and Trifecta tritoons for up to 12, a Highfield RIB, tubes, kayaks and paddleboards. Half-day and full-day rentals leave from the marina; TAP Navigator and Boat Club members save 10–50%.

features.title: Marina, fuel dock & store
features.body: One of the only Lake Texoma fuel docks open year-round, with ValvTect marine fuel, oil, tackle, bait, beer and wine, groceries, ice, firewood and fishing licenses. Covered 20–50 foot slips lease month-to-month or prepaid — the only marina on the lake that offers both.

features.title: Cruises from the charter dock
features.body: Fastrac's sunset, dinner, eagle-watching and murder-mystery cruises all depart from the Lighthouse charter dock. Stay the night and walk to the boat.

features.title: Striper Capital of the World
features.body: Lighthouse is home base for many of Texoma's top striper guides. Book a guide, buy your license at the store, and clean your catch at the fish-cleaning station on the way back to the cabin.

hubHandoff.title: Check dates, rent a boat, book it all in one place
hubHandoff.body: Cabins, RV sites, tritoons and cruises for Lighthouse are all booked on texomadestinations.com — live availability, Pay Now & Save rates and TAP member discounts included. Slip leases and the fuel dock are handled right here at the marina.

stay.title: Stay, play and tie up at Lighthouse
stay.subtitle: Everything on this page is on one property in Little Mineral — you can walk from your cabin to the boat to the store to the cruise.

sections.title: Cabins
body: Thirty-four furnished, water-view cabins that sleep anywhere from one to sixteen. Eight are the original Corps of Engineers fishing cabins — small, close to the water and beloved by anglers. Two- and three-bedroom cabins suit families; the six-bedroom houses handle reunions and corporate groups.

Every cabin includes cable television, towels and linens, basic dishes, cookware and utensils, a BBQ grill, refrigerator, microwave and coffee pot unless noted. Several cabins are pet friendly for a $35 per-pet fee. Free Wi-Fi is available across the resort, though signal varies by cabin.

image.alt: Family arriving at a Lighthouse cabin

sections.title: RV sites
body: Nineteen waterfront and lake-view gravel sites with 30- or 50-amp electric, water, a picnic table and fire ring, and a dump station on property. Up to six people (four adults) per site. Pull straight through to the boat ramp, or walk to the fuel dock for ice and firewood. Lighthouse has no tent camping.

sections.title: Boat rentals
body: Berkshire and Trifecta tritoons (24 feet, 115–200 hp, up to 11–12 guests) and a Highfield RIB for four, rented by the half day or the full day from the marina. Tubes are the most popular add-on; kayaks and paddleboards rent by the hour. Renters must be 21; you pay for the fuel you use.
TAP Navigator members save 10% on boat rentals; Big Water Boat Club members save 50% with no blackout dates.

sections.title: Marina & slips
body: Covered 20- to 50-foot slips with electricity and water included, fully enclosed boathouses, jet-ski lifts and HydroHoist lift leases. Lighthouse is the only marina on Lake Texoma that offers both prepaid and month-to-month leases — no annual contract, no hidden fees. Slips are in demand; join the waitlist and we'll call when one opens.
Transient slips for overnight cabin guests are available — ask at check-in.

sections.title: Fuel dock & general store
body: One of the only fuel docks on the lake open year-round, pumping ValvTect marine fuel. The store stocks oil and marine supplies, live and frozen bait, rods and tackle, groceries and sandwiches, beer and wine, ice, charcoal, firewood, gifts and apparel — plus Lake Texoma fishing licenses. TAP members save 5–10¢ per gallon and 5–10% in the store.

image.alt: Marina and fuel dock at Lighthouse

sections.title: Recreation & fishing
body: A lakefront playground, community fire pit, fishing pier, boat ramp and PWC ramp, fish-cleaning station and pavilion. Lighthouse sits in Little Mineral near the dam — striper water — and is home base for many of the lake's best guides. Sand bass, crappie, black bass and blue cats round out the catch.

stay.note: Cabin counts, unit photos and nightly rates are maintained on texomadestinations.com and shown live when you choose dates. Slip and lift pricing is published on the Lighthouse Marina page.

plan.title: Getting to Lighthouse
plan.subtitle: 300 Lighthouse Drive, Pottsboro — in Little Mineral on the Preston Peninsula, about 90 minutes north of Dallas.

arrival.title: Arrival & check-in
body: Check-in is 3pm and check-out is 11am at the main office. Off-peak, the office and the fuel dock are open 9am to 5pm daily; hours extend in summer. Arriving after hours? Call ahead and we'll leave instructions.
Reservations for cabins, RV sites and boat rentals are made on texomadestinations.com; the marina handles slip leases, fuel and the store.

directions: From Dallas: US-75 north to Sherman, west on SH 56/FM 1417 to Pottsboro, then SH 289 north.
From Pottsboro follow SH 289 north about 6 miles; Lighthouse Drive is on the left just past the Tackle Box.
Boaters: Lighthouse is in the Little Mineral arm on the Texas side, close to Denison Dam. Look for the lighthouse.
Fastrac cruises board at the charter dock next to the marina — park in the main lot.

groups.title: Bring your people. Make a weekend of it.
groups.subtitle: Lodging, lake experiences, gathering spaces, and more time together at Lighthouse Resort & Marina.
intro: Company fishing weekends, family reunions, and celebrations deserve a little more time together. Lighthouse brings cabins, RV sites, lake experiences, and gathering space together in one Lake Texoma home base.
Choose the pieces that fit your group and dates. Activities are not fixed packages, and availability varies; the events team can help you explore the possibilities.
